# clavis server

<p class="cli-lead">Run the Clavis server</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis server [flags]
```

</div>

Run the Clavis server: API, background jobs and the web app, in one
process. Settings come from environment variables or a `clavis.yaml`
file. Most people run the Docker image instead; see the install guide.

## Examples

```sh
clavis server
clavis server --config /etc/clavis/clavis.yaml
```

<p class="cli-example-title">Separate API and job workers</p>

```sh
clavis server --role=api
clavis server --role=worker
```
